Give your indoor Christmas tree a beautifully coordinated, classic look with this Decoris Set of 45 Oxblood Glass Baubles. The rich, deep red oxblood colour creates a warm backdrop that blends seamlessly into both traditional and modern festive themes. Crafted from elegant machine-made glass, this set features a varied mix of shiny, matte, and glitter finishes to ensure your tree catches the light brilliantly from every angle.

 Dimensions: 6cm (Diameter), perfectly sized for both small and large branches
 Material: High-quality glass for an elegant, traditional Christmas appearance
 Finish: A festive mix of shiny, matte, and glitter surfaces in a deep oxblood red

 Extras: Each bauble is fitted with a gold-coloured aluminium cap and hanging loop for quick placement

products.baseName: Charles Bentley 12 Piece Green Glass Christmas Bauble Collection
products.variantName: Charles Bentley 12 Piece Green Glass Christmas Bauble Collection
products.sourceDescription:
Add a touch of glamour to your festive décor with our elegant collection of shimmering baubles. Crafted from delicate glass, and featuring 4 beautiful designs, the collection includes classic round baubles, intricately shaped pinecones, and elegant ice drop designs – all finished in a shimmering yellow-hued finish for a refined, glistening effect.
 Perfect for creating a warm, luxurious look, these beautifully detailed decorations offer subtle sparkle and a variety of textures to elevate your seasonal styling. Style alone for a sophisticated statement or pair with other warm metallic and neutral tones for a perfectly curated Christmas look.
 ELEGANT & LUXURIOUS: These Charles Bentley baubles feature a soft shimmering yellow-hued finish for a timeless and refined festive look. Each one is crafted from delicate glass, adding a sophisticated sparkle to your tree
 VARIETY OF TEXTURE & SHAPE: This set includes 3 classic round baubles, 3 round ribbed baubles, 3 pinecone-shaped baubles, 3 elegant ice drop baubles – perfect for creating depth and interest in your Christmas décor
 PREMIUM GLASS DESIGN: Made from elegant glass, each bauble offers a lightweight yet premium feel, ensuring your decorations look and feel extra special year after year
 EASY TO STYLE: With their co-ordinating warm metallic shades and beautiful range of shapes, these baubles are ideal for mixing and matching with other neutral or metallic decorations to suit your own seasonal theme
 COMPLETE 12 PIECE SET: Everything you need to elevate your tree styling – ideal for refreshing your festive look or gifting to someone special
 DIMENSIONS: Round height: 8 cm, Round width: 8 cm, Round depth: 8 cm. Pinecone height: 10 cm, Pinecone width: 8 cm, Pinecone depth: 8 cm. Ice drop height: 13 cm, Ice drop width: 6 cm, Ice drop depth: 6 cm. Hanging cord length: 16 cm. Weight: 27 g each
 Size: ONE
 Please Note: Glass – Handle with care. Keep out of reach of young children. Store in original packaging between seasons to prevent breakage. Colours may appear different depending on the lighting conditions.

products.baseName: Lights4fun 50cm Dual Colour Micro LED Christmas Wreath
products.variantName: Lights4fun 50cm Dual Colour Micro LED Christmas Wreath
products.sourceDescription:
Give your home a cosy or contemporary festive feel with this dual colour micro LED wreath. Featuring realistic faux pine branches, this beautiful wreath measures 50cm in diameter and is lit by 100 micro LED lights scattered across the foliage, which can be set to glow in either a gleaming warm white, a lustrous cool white shade, or a combination of the two.

Use the cool white setting to style with a neutral decorative scheme – tie gleaming baubles into the foliage and suspend the wreath over a mirror. Use the warm white or combination setting to pair with ivory TruGlow® pillar candles on a mantlepiece and add a velvet bow for a luxurious touch.

All wreaths and garlands will require styling on arrival, lay flat, and tease the foliage for a styled and finished look. Shaping your foliage may result in some variance from the listed dimensions.

To illuminate, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the attached battery box. Use the switch on the box to select your preferred colourway and to set the handy 6-hour timer for an automatic glow at the same time each evening. Size: ONE Height 10cm Width 10cm Depth 10cm

products.variantName: Dibor Hampton Frosted Christmas Berries 50cm Wreath
products.sourceDescription:
A classical affair to decorate your door not only for Christmas, but all winter long, our extra large wreath follows the tradition that simplicity is sometimes best. Offering an impressive diameter, the base foliage consists of an array of evergreen pine leaves, all artfully arranged in a generous size for a truly impressive look.

For an eye-catching contrast, this giant wreath is studded with plentiful bushels of bright red berries, winking from amongst the botanical sprigs and playing into the time-honoured festive colour palette. To give our beautiful Christmas wreath the perfect finishing touch which really helps set it apart, the berries and needles are dusted with a soft flocked effect for pleasing texture and creating the impression of country hedgerows that have been kissed with fresh snowfall. An everlasting alternative to fresh arrangements that you can display year upon year, the botanical elements are all densely packed all around a lovingly crafted frame of interwoven grapevine branches that s both stylish and robust.

products.sourceDescription:
Add a festive touch to even the smallest of spaces with our Luxury 3ft pre-lit faux snowy Christmas tree. Featuring snow-dusted green branches and sat nestled in a hessian-style bag, this thoughtfully designed piece has a compact base, making it the perfect fit for tabletops, sideboards and entryways. Warm white plug-in LED lights are pre-fitted throughout, casting a soft, ambient glow that brings instant warmth and cheer.

Ideal for adding festive flair to any corner of your home, with no assembly required, this piece is a stylish favourite you'll enjoy for seasons to come.

• COMPACT & STYLISH DESIGN: Measuring 92cm tall, this small frosted Christmas tree is perfect for tabletops, sideboards, desks, and entryways – ideal for adding festive charm to smaller spaces without overwhelming the room.
• PRE-LIT WITH WARM WHITE LEDS: Fitted with warm white plug-in LED lights, this tree delivers a soft, ambient glow – ideal for creating a cosy and inviting festive atmosphere with no need for separate lighting.
• FROSTED REALISTIC BRANCHES: Designed with lifelike green branches dusted in artificial snow, this tree captures the look and feel of a classic winter scene – perfect for adding a touch of seasonal magic to your home.
• READY TO DISPLAY: Nestled in a hessian-style sack base for a natural, handcrafted look, this tree arrives pre-assembled and ready to enjoy straight from the box – no setup required.
• FESTIVE FAVOURITE: Designed for indoor use, this mini tree is a convenient and charming seasonal accent you’ll look forward to displaying year after year.

• Dimensions:
 • Tree height: 92cm
 • Tree width: 76cm
 • Base height: 10cm
• Weight: 2.5kg
• Cable length: 90cm
• Tips: 584

Additional Information:
Battery operated, requires 3 x AA batteries (batteries are not included)

products.variantName: Charles Bentley Green 55cm Pre-Lit Christmas Berry & Pinecone Eucalyptus Wreath
products.sourceDescription:
Welcome guests in festive style with our indoor outdoor 60cm prelit white berry & pinecone eucalyptus wreath, a timeless Christmas classic perfect for any front door or festive display. Lightly dusted with a snowy finish and adorned with white berries & pinecones, our prelit wreath brings a touch of winter wonder to any space. Warm white Micro LED lights are woven throughout the frosted greenery, casting a soft, magical glow that’s perfect for creating a cosy, inviting atmosphere. Battery powered for easy placement, this wreath is ideal for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use – decorate doors, windows, mantels, or walls with ease. Whether you're refreshing your holiday décor or starting a new tradition, this elegant wreath is designed to bring festive charm to your home year after year.
 CLASSIC CHRISTMAS STYLE: This 55cm Charles Bentley Green Wreath adds timeless festive charm to your front door, windows, or interior spaces with its full, natural-looking greenery.
 WARM WHITE LED LIGHTS: Prelit with soft, warm white LED bulbs to create a cosy and inviting glow throughout the festive season.
 BATTERY OPERATED & WIREFREE: Powered by batteries (not included), this wreath is easy to place anywhere – no plug sockets or unsightly cables needed.
 SUITABLE FOR INDOOR & OUTDOOR USE: Designed to be displayed inside or outside – perfect for doors, porches, fireplaces, or hallway walls.
 Easy to store, this wreath provides seasonal use with simple styling and setup.
 DIMENSIONS: Height: 55cm, Width: 55cm, Depth: 20cm
 Weight: 1.2kg
 50 timer bulbs
 ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Batteries NOT included 3x AA required
 Size: ONE

Adorn your staircase with this pre lit oversized white berry garland! Bringing the outside in with a fresh and festive look, this garland is packed full of mixed faux foliage and finished with white berries and micro lights for a Christmas sparkle.
